type Config struct{Disabled bool; Strategy Strategy; Correlation Correlation; Header string; CorrelationHeader string}
func Configure(c Config) (restore func(), err error)
type Correlation uint8
const CorrelationGenerate Correlation
const CorrelationInherit Correlation
const CorrelationNone Correlation
func Extract(ctx context.Context, h http.Header) context.Context
func From(ctx context.Context) IDs
type IDs struct{Request string; Correlation string}
func Inject(ctx context.Context, h http.Header)
type Strategy uint8
const StrategyAuto Strategy
const StrategyNone Strategy
const StrategyTimestamp Strategy
const StrategyTrace Strategy
const StrategyUUID Strategy
func With(ctx context.Context, id string) context.Context
func WithCorrelation(ctx context.Context, id string) context.Context
